gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-roundo: Wobbly, nearly sealed bowls give Jelly Crazies its jellied look, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. And Roundo keeps its small counters unclogged, so paragraphs of sans text move along at an easy pace.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-spline-sans: Playful and wobbly, Jelly Crazies stands tall in the lowercase, its bowls nearly sealed shut. Spline Sans sits lower, a plain sans with wide gaps at its curve ends, so paragraphs flow without snagging.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-synonym: Jelly Crazies wobbles with no calligraphic thinning, its bowls nearly sealed, while Synonym keeps generous openings in every curve. The heading earns its keep when it runs big and brief.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-almendra: Jelly Crazies wobbles, with bowls that nearly seal shut. It is made for big, playful moments, while Almendra, a serif with a deep midsection in the lowercase, is the one with dignity for steady reading.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-bree-serif: Jelly Crazies draws strokes like twine pressed into a flat surface, best at pulling a glance with its wobble. Bree Serif, literary and refined with outsized lowercase, does the quieter work of carrying the reading.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-port-lligat-: Jelly Crazies wobbles with nearly sealed bowls, while Port Lligat Slab, a serif, has lowercase counters like wide glass portholes. Give the serif body a generous size so those portholes open up.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-quando: All wobble, no thinning: Jelly Crazies keeps its strokes unshaded while Quando, bookish and traditional, stands tall with sparse, wide spacing. The heading brings the jolt, and the text lets the page settle.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-outfit: Jelly-soft wobble, with bowls that nearly seal shut. Jelly Crazies is best loud and large, while Outfit, whose cable-like curves finish well before they close, does the quiet talking.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-plus-jakarta-sa: Plus Jakarta Sans is a modern, precise monoline sans. Against Jelly Crazies and its nearly sealed bowls, those well-spaced curve endings make the sharpest difference: jelly-soft wobble meets precise, open lines.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk draws each glyph as a ribbon of constant width. Beside the tall, wobbly Jelly Crazies, its counters breathe open, so the heading gets the fun while the text stays easy to follow.
